Test a chat feature in a local web app running at http://localhost:4567 (this is "FanBox", a desktop file manager app; we just added an AI chat window).

Steps:
1. Navigate to http://localhost:4567 and wait for it to load (it may take 1-2s).
2. In the top toolbar there is a button labeled "对话" (id="btn-chat"). Click it. A chat overlay panel titled "AI 对话" should appear.
3. In the chat overlay, there is a backend dropdown (id="chat-backend") at top-left — make sure it is set to "Cursor" (the default).
4. There is a textarea at the bottom (id="chat-input") with placeholder "问点什么…". Click it and type exactly: Reply with exactly one word: pong
5. Click the "发送" button (id="chat-send") to send.
6. WAIT and observe. The assistant bubble first shows "思考中…" then should stream a response. The Cursor backend can take 15-40 seconds to respond, so wait patiently — take a snapshot/screenshot every ~5 seconds, up to ~60 seconds total, until the assistant bubble shows actual text (expected: "pong") instead of "思考中…".
7. Take a final screenshot.

Report back clearly:
- Did the chat overlay open? 
- Did a user bubble with your message appear?
- Did the assistant bubble eventually show a real response (what text)? Or did it show an error (⚠ ...)? Quote any error text exactly.
- Include the final screenshot.

Do NOT type anything else or click other buttons. Keep it to this one test.
</user_query>
